observations: The page number «85» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L05 continue the example of p. 84 (JP2 0116, L23-L35): the mean places of the sun and the moon at the mean opposition, «98° 25′ 21″», the sums of p. 84 less 360°.

L01-L05 and L19-L21: the computations, set as the tables of p. 82 (JP2 0114, L30-L34): each half with its names at the left and its figures in a column, the heads of L01 in the smaller type; dotted leaders after «n. Tafel 21 :» and «n. Tafel 23 :» (L04), not transcribed; rules under the figures of L04 and L20, the sums below them; «— 26′ 52″», «— 5° 49′ 12″», the minus a long dash after a word space. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed. L26-L35: the two computations of the corrections, set in two columns, transcribed one after the other, the left column first: the names at the left, the figures in a column at the right, dotted leaders after «Argument der Breite», «des Mondes :», «Anomalie des Mondes» and «korrigierte Anomalie4) :», not transcribed; rules under the figures of L27, L30 and L33.

L10-L14. Checked: 0 Rabīʿ II 146 is 16 June 763 (1 Rabīʿ II is 17 June, p. 84, N03), so that 13d 14h after its noon is 2 in the morning of 30 June 763, 14 hours after noon of 13 Rabīʿ II (29 June), as L12-L14 say. N02: Meeus's algorithm gives the true full moon at 2.63h Terrestrial Time on 30 June 763; with a ΔT of about 0.9h (Espenak and Meeus) this is about 1h 43m at Greenwich, near Schram's 1h 41m; Cordova lies 19 minutes west of Greenwich. With the sine rule of p. 46 (JP2 0078) the lunar equation for 68° 17′ from the apogee is about 4° 35′, the hourly true motion of the moon about 31′ 54″ (Table 63: 31′ 50″); the values of Tables 21, 23 and 63 are to be compared with the tables.

L11: «13d14h», the figures and the raised letters set close (5-6 px), where L09-L10 set «10,97h» and «10h 58m» with a word space; L34: «10h 58m3)», the note number after the m. L31: «359° 11′ 53 ″», the sign of the seconds after a gap of 17 px, about a narrow word space; transcribed as printed. L12: «Rabīʿ II» upright here, with the macron and the ʿayn raised.
N02: «Schrams» spaced twice; N04: «Batt.» spaced, «Anomalia aequata» in italics. L11-L12: «Opposi-|tion» in italics.
The colons and the semicolon stand after the thin space of the edition (9-18 px measured).
